story.festival_newyear.name: New year
story.festival_newyear.desc: A new-year challenge: craft twenty-five things for a fresh start.
story.festival_newyear.ch.c1.sum: A new year begins somewhere on Earth. Craft twenty-five things.
story.festival_newyear.r1.start: A new year is beginning! Time to make things new. Craft twenty-five things — anything from the workbench or by hand — and red lights are yours.
story.festival_newyear.graduated: Happy new year! Red lamps and lanterns for good luck.
story.festival_newyear.d1.start: Craft twenty-five things, by hand or at any station.
story.festival_newyear.d1.done: Twenty-five things made. A good start to the year.
